---
title: natbib document with a citation
format: pdf
cite-method: natbib
bibliography: natbib.bib
biblio-style: plainnat
_quarto:
  tests:
    pdf:
      noErrors: []
      printsMessage:
        level: INFO
        regex: 'generating bibliography'
      ensurePdfRegexMatches:
        - ['The TeXbook']
        - []
---

This document cites @knuth with `cite-method: natbib`, so the `.aux` file has `\citation`, `\bibdata` and `\bibstyle`, and BibTeX must run to produce the bibliography.
